data.desc: PodcastOne, Inc. (NASDAQ:PODC), a subsidiary of LiveOne, Inc. (NASDAQ:LVO), is a leading podcast platform offering creators and advertisers a full 360-degree solution spanning sales, marketing, public relations, production, and distribution. Its distribution network delivers more than 1 billion monthly impressions across channels including YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and iHeartRadio. The company has surpassed 3.9 billion total downloads with a community of more than 200 top podcasters. For more information, visit www.podcastone.
